description.value: The Steveston Cafe & Hotel is a heritage property established in 1895 in the heart of Steveston Village, one of the most historically rich and cycle-friendly communities in Metro Vancouver. The building survived the great fire of 1918 and once housed soldiers during the 1900 fishing strike, and today it operates a popular breakfast cafe, bar, and liquor store on the ground floor. Cyclists staying here are steps from the Fraser River dyke trail, whale-watching tours, fresh seafood restaurants, and the working fishing docks that make Steveston a beloved destination.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates OSM contact details (phone, address, website). The amenities page lists facilities in detail but makes no mention of bike storage, bike rooms, or any cycling-specific services; the building is a heritage property with no elevator and all rooms on the second floor, which would complicate bringing bikes inside. Wi-Fi is confirmed free in rooms by both OSM tags and the website; the on-site bar and restaurant plus Steveston Village's many eateries confirm nearby evening food.
concerns: No mention of secure bike storage or any bike-specific amenities anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
Heritage building with no elevator; all guest rooms on second floor — loading touring bikes or e-bikes into rooms would be impractical.
Contact page displays Christmas 2022 business hours, suggesting that page has not been updated in several years, though the rest of the site appears current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The hotel is a legitimate, operating accommodation in a prime cycling destination (Steveston Village, dyke trail access), but the website makes no mention of secure bike storage or any cycling-specific facilities, and the heritage building's lack of elevator and second-floor-only rooms make in-room bike storage unlikely. Direct inquiry to confirm bike storage arrangements is needed before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Steveston Village and the adjacent dyke trail are popular cycling routes; a hotel here with confirmed bike storage would be a strong WWC listing. A single follow-up call could resolve the key unknown.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site bar and restaurant; website also notes Steveston Village has 'many tasty fresh seafood restaurants' nearby

Wi-Fi.detail: WiFi is available in hotel rooms and is free of charge, per the amenities page
